body: Leading-zero numeric_code promotion Sharpen rule. ROOT CAUSE (2026-06-17): feature_sharpen.rs Rule F1 is the only numeric_code-promotion rule and DELIBERATELY excludes integer_number (only postal_code/cpt -> numeric_code on leading zeros, comment lines 134-137). So all-digit columns with prevalent leading zeros (036/076/06075) that Sense calls integer_number are never promoted -> they cast to BIGINT and lose the zeros (the exact failure numeric_code exists to prevent). FIX: tight value-based rule (0048, like full_name_username_veto) promoting integer_number -> numeric_code when leading-zero ratio is HIGH (>=0.5) AND values are consistent fixed-width all-digit (width-consistency guard separates a real code column from F1's feared 'occasional zero-padded integer'). NOT a retrain (model+generator+HAS_LEADING_ZERO feature all work; it's a Sharpen precedence gap). GATING: gold no-regression + corpus-honest gate (same over-emit-into-integer risk zone F1 avoided; tight guard + both-sides evidence). SCOPE: fixes leading-zero subpop only; bare-ID cases (GAME_ID, no zeros) correctly stay integer (contestable role slice, needs semantic signal). Verified: /tmp/lzcode.csv (036/840/076/124/06075/0001) -> integer_number, no rule fired, zeros confirmed reaching the model via all_varchar ingestion.
